interpretation: Each retained or new run satisfies epoch>=50 and bad>=15, with cap200 and all-time validation-best selection.
Minimum50 does not imply a sufficiently converged model or an optimal floor. Some all-time best checkpoints may be earlier than50.
Post-best values can fluctuate; being lower than a selected maximum is not independent evidence of overfitting.
Fresh training prefixes can differ from earlier runs, so observed changes cannot be attributed solely to the stopping gate.
Logged epoch durations are observational and cannot replace controlled isolated X6 costs.
